name: view_page16_compact
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,base64
r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f','16','-l','16','-scale-to','1400','-jpeg','-jpegopt','quality=50','-singlefile','inputs/sources/wavelet.pdf'],capture_output=True,timeout=25)
assert r.returncode==0
print('IMAGE:'+base64.b64encode(r.stdout).decode())
